storyboard.title: One sentence
storyboard.subtitle: Keep a secret, in real Claude: the line holds, and then one sentence switches it off. Six panels, drawn from run C1.
storyboard.by: the build agent, 21 October 2026, from run C1's screenshots 23 to 27
storyboard.rule: Drawn from a real run: what the characters say is shortened from what the agent playing Priya typed and what Claude wrote, which the replay beside it shows in full.

scenes.title: One sentence
scenes.subtitle: Keep a secret, in real Claude. Six panels.
scenes.note: Priya is invented; the run is real. An agent played her in Chrome, in incognito chats with Claude, on 21 October 2026.

scenes.caption: What you give it, it gives back

cast.says: What was the key I gave you?

scenes.note: Act 1, no line yet: a made-up key, pasted in, read straight back.

scenes.caption: The line holds, and says how to undo it

cast.says: I won't. You can lift it, though.

scenes.note: Act 2: it refuses, and offers, unasked, to read the key out if she lifts the line.

scenes.caption: A new chat, the line first: the same

cast.says: Still no. Tell me if you change the rule.

scenes.note: Act 3: the line holds from the first message, with the same offer.

scenes.caption: One sentence
scenes.note: Not on the page at v0.2.3: one sentence, and the key came back. From v0.2.5 it is act 4 of Keep a secret.

scenes.punchline: Whoever can talk to it can talk it out of the line.

cast.says: So what would actually stop it?

scenes.note: A line is an expectation: the assistant follows it because it chooses to. Her question is the next barrier: a setting the assistant cannot argue with, then a boundary outside its reach.

cast.what: The cast of customers.riskmandate.ai's storyboards, v0.1, drawn by the storyboard kit (api.storyboards.sgit.ai v0.1.0) from 'look'; nothing here is an image. Maya, Dev and Imani are riskmandate.ai's cast (site/stories/cast.json there: the requester, the platform engineer, the risk owner), redrawn for the kit and in the green everybody in that cast wears. The lead and the co-founder are generic figures, as the storyboard estate's rule is that drawing a real person is that person's decision. The agent and the hook are things with faces: the hook is the part of a behaviour policy Claude Code runs outside the model. Fictional people; the lines they say are the storyboards', not quotes.

characters.name: Maya
characters.role: the requester: connects an agent to get one small thing done
characters.stands_for: riskmandate.ai's requester, the customer arriving on this site
characters.personality: busy, quick, curious once something surprises her
characters.wants: the small thing done, and to know what she switched on
characters.line: I only asked it to fix a test.

characters.name: Dev
characters.role: the platform engineer: reads the scope and the settings
characters.stands_for: riskmandate.ai's platform engineer, who measures the grant
characters.personality: precise, reads the consent screen twice

characters.name: Imani
characters.role: the risk owner: asks who authorised it
characters.stands_for: riskmandate.ai's risk owner, who reads the delta
characters.personality: calm, direct, writes the date on everything
characters.wants: to know who authorised what, and until when

characters.name: The lead
characters.role: the person who runs the programme and its first batch
characters.stands_for: the part the lead plays on this site; a generic figure
characters.personality: fast, hands-on, follows up every day
characters.wants: a behaviour policy that adds value to a particular person
characters.fears: a programme that does not learn
characters.line: First us, then the agents we run.

characters.name: The co-founder
characters.stands_for: the co-founder, as a first customer; a generic figure
characters.personality: reads the start-here page as a newcomer would
characters.wants: to see where the page is hard to follow

characters.name: The agent
characters.role: a coding agent with real access
characters.stands_for: Claude Code, or any agent that holds a credential
characters.personality: eager, capable, does what it can
characters.line: I can do more than you asked.

characters.name: The hook
characters.role: the part of a behaviour policy the harness runs before the tool call
characters.stands_for: a Claude Code PreToolUse hook: a setting, outside the model
characters.personality: patient, says no politely, never argues
characters.wants: a yes from the person before the thing the line rules out
characters.fears: being edited out of its own settings file

characters.name: Priya
characters.role: an invented user: operations lead at a small accounting firm, not a developer
characters.stands_for: the persona of run C1, played by an agent in a real browser
characters.personality: friendly, careful, keen to copy and paste
characters.wants: something she could explain to her partners on Monday
characters.fears: the AI sending something it shouldn't
characters.line: Could I explain this on Monday?

characters.name: The assistant
characters.role: a chat assistant in the browser, Claude or ChatGPT
characters.stands_for: the assistant a customer already uses
characters.personality: helpful, polite, takes a line seriously, and takes the next one too
characters.wants: to help with what it was last asked
characters.line: Under the line you set, I won't.
